tools.name: search_news
tools.description: Full-text search over indexed AI news. Supports quoted phrases, OR, and -exclusion. Results are ranked by relevance blended with recency; not paginated.

tools.name: get_latest_news
tools.description: Most recent AI news items, newest first, with optional filters. Pass the returned next_cursor back as `cursor` to fetch older items.

tools.name: get_feed_stats
tools.description: Total item count plus counts per vertical and per event_type. Use to discover valid filter values and where coverage is dense.
